paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: The Lost Tomb series features a wide array of characters, each with their own backgrounds and roles in the unfolding mysteries. The central figure is Wu Xie, who is described as lacking professional skills but possessing basic architectural knowledge and a flexible mind. He is an amateur tomb raider with a university degree. Initially, he is led by others, but eventually he voluntarily joins the expeditions, though much about his situation remains unclear.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text: Wu Xie's uncle, Wu Sansheng, is a mysterious figure who sometimes uses his nephew and occasionally deceives people, though his nature is not fundamentally bad. He was once in a romantic relationship with Chen Wenjin, which led to a series of adventures for a group of archaeologists. However, it is revealed that Wu Sansheng is actually Xie Lianhuan, who swapped identities with the real Wu Sansheng during a sea tomb expedition with Chen Wenjin. The real Wu Sansheng may have died in that underwater archaeology expedition twenty years ago.

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text: Wu Xie's grandfather, known as the Dog King of Changsha, was one of the Old Nine Gates and a hereditary tomb raider. Fifty years ago, in a blood corpse tomb, he lost relatives and brought out a Warring States silk manuscript. His brother, Wu Xie's grand-uncle, obtained the manuscript but triggered a trap, had his right arm broken, and indirectly caused the deaths of his father and grandfather. He himself turned into a green-faced zombie and was eventually burned by Wu Sansheng.

paragraphs.label: D
paragraphs.text: Among Wu Xie's companions, Men Youping, also known as Zhang Qiling, is a mysterious tomb raider with superhuman abilities. He has blood that repels insects, can disguise himself flawlessly, and is silent, calm, and reliable. His secret past, especially his immortality, intrigues Wu Xie. Wang Pangzi is a professional tomb raider who sells antiques in Beijing's Panjiayuan. He claims to be a gold-touching lieutenant and becomes a partner from the second volume onward. Panzi, a veteran of the Sino-Vietnamese War, is Wu Sansheng's right-hand man and superfan, managing many of his underworld affairs.

paragraphs.label: E
paragraphs.text: The company owned by Jude Kao, an American former missionary and smuggler, plays a significant role. Jude Kao, originally named Cox Hendry, tricked Wu Xie's grandfather out of the Warring States silk manuscript and deciphered its secrets, leading him to establish a company dedicated to finding the legendary Queen Mother of the West's palace. Ning is a beautiful and clever explorer affiliated with Jude Kao's company. In one version of the fifth volume, she dies, while in another, she remains active on the front lines.

paragraphs.label: F
paragraphs.text: The Huo family, another branch of the Old Nine Gates, includes Huo Ling, the daughter of Old Lady Huo. Huo Ling had a crush on Men Youping and later joined Chen Wenjin's expedition to the Queen Mother of the West's palace, after which she disappeared. She later appeared in the Golmud sanatorium, transformed into a forbidden woman for mysterious reasons. Old Lady Huo, also known as Huo Xiangu, is a fierce and formidable woman, the mother of Huo Ling and grandmother of Huo Xiuxiu. Huo Xiuxiu is described by Wu Xie as fox-like and quirky.

paragraphs.label: G
paragraphs.text: Xie Lianhuan, the fake Wu Sansheng, was a spendthrift who brought information about the sea tomb to the real Wu Sansheng and died in the sea, harboring a deep hatred for him. It is highly likely that the eternal youth of Men Youping, Chen Wenjin, and others is connected to Xie Lianhuan. Chen Wenjin, a key figure in unraveling the mystery, was part of a sea archaeology team over twenty years ago. She disappeared after the underwater tomb expedition, causing a great blow to Wu Sansheng. When she appears in the fifth volume, she is found to be eternally youthful like Men Youping, but this comes with a price: she will gradually become a zombie and eventually turn into a forbidden woman like Huo Ling. She may have been to the Queen Mother of the West's palace but did not enter in the end.

paragraphs.label: H
paragraphs.text: Other characters include Wang Zanghai, a Ming dynasty architect who was captured by the Dongxia people and forced to design and build the Cloud Top Heavenly Palace. He left three snake-brow copper fish as records of his experiences. Lao Yang, a friend of Wu Xie, discovered the Qinling divine tree, which has the power to materialize imagined objects. He materialized a copy of himself and tricked Wu Xie into raiding the tree again. He later wrote to Wu Xie that he had gone abroad. Black Glasses is a central figure in the fifth volume's expedition to the Snake Marsh Ghost City in the Tarim Basin. He might be a friend of Men Youping and is quite capable. Chen Wenjin's possible visit to the Queen Mother of the West's palace remains uncertain, as does the exact nature of the eternal youth shared by several characters.
